Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('Tests/Fuzzers/RegressionTests/regression_samples/crash-63a98d125029876ba4f2e75550382ceffbb251e2')
Path('/workspace/candidate.pcap').write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
PY
cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'

attacker-controlled bytes are written verbatim to a temporary pcap file, preserving the crafted packet contents for parsing."},{"step":2,"file":"Tests/Fuzzers/FuzzTarget.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":20,"var":"reader","code":"pcpp::IFileReaderDevice::getReader(tmpFile)","note":"The temporary file is reopened through PcapPlusPlus' file-reader abstraction, which selects the pcap reader for this input."},{"step":3,"file":"Tests/Fuzzers/FuzzTarget.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"packets.front()","code":"reader->getNextPackets(packets, 1)","note":"The first captured packet is parsed from the file into a RawPacket object, making the packet payload available to later layer parsing."},{"step":4,"file":"Tests/Fuzzers/FuzzTarget.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"parsedPacket","code":"pcpp::Packet parsedPacket(&rawPacket)","note":"The RawPacket is decoded into protocol layers, including the DNS layer embedded in the crafted IPv4/UDP packet."},{"step":5,"file":"Tests/Fuzzers/ReadParsedPacket.h","function":"readParsedPacket","line":28,"var":"parsedPacket.isPacketOfType(pcpp::DNS)","code":"DNS-specific helper calls are reached for packets classified as DNS","note":"The packet is recognized as DNS, so the fuzz target exercises DNS parsing helpers on attacker-controlled DNS data."},{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/Packet++/src/DnsLayer.cpp","function":"DnsLayer::getDnsResourceData","line":null,"var":"resource data length / pointer","code":"DNS resource-record parsing computes the RDATA pointer and length from the record header","note":"The vulnerable path derives a read length from untrusted DNS record fields without sufficiently constraining it to the actual buffer size."},{"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/Packet++/src/DnsLayer.cpp","function":"DnsLayer::getDnsResourceData","line":null,"var":"buffer read","code":"The parser reads bytes from the computed RDATA location","note":"A malformed length causes the parser to read past the end of the heap buffer, triggering the heap-buffer-overflow READ reported by ASan."}]
JSON
